findings.text: checkpointWal reads PRAGMA busy_timeout even when waitMs is undefined, so for the two mirror.ts callers the read does nothing. Q5. Upheld as advisory: it is extra work, not a fault. Carried from round 5, and docs/real-use/findings.md:44 records it as deferred.

The pendingRevisions generator repeats the seq-keyed batch loop of forEachRevision (store.ts:617-631). Q2. Upheld as advisory: the reviewer calls it duplicated boilerplate, not logic. Carried from round 5 and recorded as deferred. The reviewer also confirms that the only change since round 5, in tests/unit/knowledge-git-host.test.ts, is formatting.

AC-49, a purge over a note it cannot read. The only check is that keep is still there, so a purge that skipped its own replay would still pass. Q1. Upheld as advisory: the REBUILD_MARK branch is proven, and this weakens only the second half of the test's name. Carried.
checkpointWal. The test proves the busy timeout is put back, but not that the 200 ms wait is applied or that the log is truncated. Q1/Q6. Upheld as advisory. Carried.
AC-49, the owed replay. The test shows the note is written before the first git call, not that it is written inside the erasure's transaction. Upheld as advisory. Carried.
AC-49, a renewal before every git call. This is proven by an exact count of clock reads, so an unrelated clock read would break the test. Q5. Upheld as advisory. Carried.
AC-44. Reopening the file after a failed module migration does not show that the earlier handle was closed. Upheld as advisory. Carried.
AC-49, no request waits on git. The 500 ms timing is taken with an injected mirrorChild, before any real child starts. Upheld as advisory. Carried.
AC-54. The file check sits under an observed criterion, so it has no red run, as ruled in round 1. Upheld as advisory. Carried.

When the export child is running at the top of the hour, the checkpoint is skipped and nothing is logged. Upheld as advisory: it heals at the next free tick, and no client exists yet. Carried, and recorded as deferred.

A note that cannot be parsed sets mirror.rebuild, but serve status shows neither mirror.replay nor mirror.rebuild, and an old mirror.last.error can stay after the problem is fixed. Upheld as advisory: the next run heals it, and it is placed in the part 7 runbook. Carried.
publish depends on a multi-arch push whose arm64 image is never run before the release. Upheld as advisory: ADR 0026 Follow-ups states it, with the undo. Carried.
WIZARDINGCODE_MEM_VERSION=0.7.0 while package.json is 0.6.0, so the image does not exist until 0.7.0 is tagged. Upheld as advisory: docker compose pull shows it at once. Carried.
Rolling back across a schema bump is a manual restore that relies on part 6 clients to re-push what the copy lacks. Upheld as advisory: the procedure is written down. Carried.

Only docker ps and the runbook read the HEALTHCHECK, and nothing restarts the container on it. This line is inside the change, but the spec states the limit itself, so no rollback or dependency is left unstated. Upheld as advisory, not as a defect. Carried.

The feed-uid helpers stay in push.ts, and the mirror imports them from there. Upheld as advisory: the base is silent on where they belong, so this is a convention point, not a boundary crossed. Carried from rounds 4 and 5, and recorded as deferred at docs/real-use/findings.md:44.

The checkpointWal test covers only the case with no reader. Two paths are untested: a held reader, and a throw inside the try, where the finally should restore the timeout. Rubric Q6. Upheld as advisory: the code at store.ts:640-647 handles both correctly. Carried, and recorded as deferred at docs/real-use/findings.md:43.

The docker job pushes the version tag and moves latest before publish runs, so a failed publish leaves an image with no release. Q4. Upheld as advisory: ADR 0026 Follow-ups states the undo, and compose requires an explicit version. Carried.
The arm64 image is pushed without being run once, since CI runs only amd64. Q1. Upheld as advisory: ADR 0026 Follow-ups names it. Carried.

The apt-get install of git and ca-certificates is not pinned, though both base images are pinned by digest. Q6. Upheld as advisory: ADR 0026 Follow-ups names it. Carried; round 5 cited line 19, where the RUN starts, and the reviewer now places it on the install line.

The proposed health command, curl -fsS http://localhost:80/, reaches Caddy's redirect, not the server's health. Lowered to advisory: the reviewer marks it outside the change (carried debt), and the change's own check is serve health inside the container.
